ui_create_project_describe_the_short_dra:
Describe the short drama you want; a simple idea is fine. Click "Polish brief with AI" at the top right to expand it.

[Lead character]
• Name, gender, public identity and hidden identity
• Core personality, current predicament, goal and cost of failure

[Story framework]
• Opening situation: what crisis, betrayal or opportunity starts the story
• Core conflict: who stands in the lead's way, and why the conflict keeps escalating
• Identity reversal: how the lead's hidden advantage, evidence or secret pays off
• Revenge / comeback path: how the lead fights back step by step
• Climax and ending: how the final showdown and relationships resolve

[Key scenes] (optional)
• Episode-one hook, mid-season twist, final showdown

[Special requests] (optional)
• Romance, villain, special power, era, profession or world-building
• No suffering lead / fast pace / lots of twists / fixed ending / must-keep plot points
